scope: Software colour conversion and private compositor readback

loader.source: Native macOS CoreGraphics Display P3 to extended linear Rec.2020 numerical reference

compositor.application: Staged Loupe using the reviewed image-colour package source
compositor.reference: Float32 TIFF with linear Rec.2020 ICC containing the native macOS numerical reference

controls: The float TIFF preserves the extended reference components; a PNG reference clipped them and produced a misleading 17-code saturated-red discrepancy.
The installed Loupe AppArmor profile rejected the isolated Wayland socket, so compositor readback uses the staged executable.
The comparison samples patch interiors with identical layout and excludes interface pixels.
acceptance_limits: The image-loader comparison covers installed software; the Loupe compositor comparison covers a private staged executable.
These synthetic patches do not establish accuracy for all image formats and colours.
